mechanism: Amphetamines increase dopaminergic activity while quetiapine antagonizes dopamine receptors, creating opposing pharmacodynamic effects; amphetamines also increase sympathomimetic activity that may be enhanced by quetiapine's anticholinergic properties.
action: Concurrent use requires careful monitoring for reduced efficacy of quetiapine and increased risk of cardiovascular and CNS stimulation; consider alternative stimulant therapy or dose adjustment with close clinical supervision.
